craftStory.title: From Uttar Pradesh to Your Home
craftStory.subtitle: Direct maker sourcing from Muzaffarnagar workshops
paragraphs: For generations, communities across Uttar Pradesh have mastered the craft of transforming riverbank reeds and wild bamboo into lightweight, remarkably durable seating known as the Mudha.

Instead of buying through tiered wholesale markets, regional traders, and expensive urban retail stores, we work directly with small manufacturing workshops and craftspeople in Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh.

This direct connection allows us to offer honest pricing, ensure each piece is constructed with seasoned bamboo frames and traditional weaving techniques, and ship them safely to apartments and homes across India.
craftStory.disclaimer: Transparency Note: We are a low-inventory direct-sourcing brand. We do not make unsupported claims about environmental certification or artisan wage multipliers — we simply provide honest, high-quality traditional craft directly from the makers to you.

faqs.a: A Mudha (also spelled Mudda or Mooda) is a traditional Indian stool or low chair crafted from wild river reeds (Sarkanda) and seasoned bamboo canes, bound tightly with natural jute or cotton twine. It has been a beloved fixture in Indian courtyards, verandas, and tea stalls for centuries due to its lightweight mobility and natural ergonomic comfort.

faqs.q: What material is it made from?
faqs.a: Our Mudhas are crafted using natural, seasoned bamboo poles for structural rings and frameworks, tightly bundled wild river reeds for the cylindrical base, and woven cane or jute for the seating surface. (Exact reed variety and binding fiber may vary slightly by seasonal harvest and will be confirmed with each supplier batch).

faqs.q: How much weight can it support?
faqs.a: Standard Mudha stools typically support between 110 kg and 120 kg, while large back-support Mudhas support up to 130 kg due to their reinforced dual-ring bamboo structure. *(Exact maximum certified load capacities are undergoing formal supplier testing and will be updated upon lab certification).*

Yes! Mudhas are ideal for covered balconies, verandas, terraces, and gardens. Because bamboo and reeds are organic natural fibers, we recommend keeping them in covered outdoor areas during heavy direct monsoon downpours and allowing them to dry in open air if damp.

Our standard stools are approximately 15" diameter × 15" height (seat height 15"). Our back-support chairs are approximately 20" diameter × 28" total backrest height (seat height 14"). *(Because these are handcrafted, natural variations of ±1 inch can occur between individual pieces).*
Zero assembly required! Every Mudha arrives 100% pre-assembled, structurally bound, and ready for you to sit on right out of the box.

Because Mudhas are bulky items shipped via surface cargo carriers, delivery typically takes 4–7 business days for major Indian metros and 6–10 business days for Tier 2/3 cities and regional addresses.
Yes, we ship to all serviceable postal PIN codes across India via reliable surface freight logistics partners specializing in furniture transport.

faqs.q: What happens if the product arrives damaged?
faqs.a: We provide a 100% Free Transit Replacement Guarantee. If your Mudha incurs damage during transit, simply snap 2–3 clear photographs of the damage and outer packaging within 48 hours of delivery and submit our quick online replacement form or WhatsApp us. We will dispatch a brand-new replacement at zero cost to you.

faqs.q: Can I order multiple Mudhas for my café, resort, or project?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Commercial B2B inquiries for cafés, restaurants, farmhouses, event designers, and boutique hotels are welcome. We offer tiered bulk freight discounts for orders of 10 or more units via our Bulk Inquiry form.
